hook: Breed a swelling herd of lemmings, then choose each turn: hoard them as an endless tide or cash them in.
loop: Make Kits; extras that don't fit wait in the Burrow.
Grow Kit count and Kit size; the two multiply.
Pour Kits out through Onward, or spend them on real units.

growth.line: Kit count and Kit size both rise each turn and multiply; spending turns them into permanent stats.

feel.early: Free Kit bodies fill gaps and attack first.
feel.mid: A growing Burrow; every turn a keep-or-spend call.
feel.late: Endless Onward tides, a growing Banner, or giant real units.

stars.why: Names the comp at Tier 3: the Burrow becomes fight HP.
Drains half the Burrow into stats, pulling against the Onward tide.
A Banner that grows as each front Kit dies.

card_short.u02: End of Turn: make a Kit.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: gold per 5 Herd Kits, at most 2.
card_short.u04: When played: Kit size +2 Attack or +2 Health.
card_short.u05: Onward; gives another unit Onward and makes a Kit.
card_short.u06: Your front unit has Onward, up to 3 times a fight.
card_short.u07: End of Turn: a Kit per 4 in your Herd.
card_short.u08: When played: cash up to 3 Burrow Kits into stats.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: 3 Burrow Kits fall on enemies as damage.
card_short.u10: When played: a nearby Kit becomes a copy of a neighbour.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: spend 2 Burrow Kits, Kit size +1/+1.
card_short.u12: Each Kit you make brings another into the Burrow.
card_short.u13: Your Kits have Bristle 3; falling Kits hit harder.
card_short.u14: Start of Turn: doubles your Burrow, up to 6 Kits.
card_short.u15: When a Kit dies, your biggest unit gains its stats.
card_short.u16: Onward. Start of Combat: Kits grow with Burrow size.
card_short.u18: Front unit gets a Banner that grows as holders die.
card_short.u19: End of Turn: half the Burrow becomes permanent stats.
card_short.x01: Lemming token at Kit size; overflow waits in the Burrow.

builds.name: The Endless Tide
builds.line: Build a huge Burrow and pour it out through Onward.

builds.name: The Crossing
builds.line: Few strong units, often borrowed, fed Kits by Raft-builder and Ferrywife.

builds.name: The Banner
builds.line: Brother Onward's Banner grows as front Kits die; a sturdy catcher behind.

liked: Brother Onward's growing Banner: all three named it a standout payoff.
One pile of Kits pulled several ways gives a real choice every turn.
worries: Golden Cantor of the Edge can stack huge fight stats on one unit.
Watch Ferrywife, Herding Council, Herald, Brother Onward growth; Gerd's Bristle Kits risk ties.
changed: Herding Council now grows Kit size; Tally pays gold for a big Herd.
Front unit and turn order are now tribe rules; several rules gaps closed.
Gerd boosts Ole's falling Kits; Snow Hall Guard scales with the Burrow.
verdict: Rated 7 fun and 6.7 distinct, it ranked first of its seed's three; for players who like hoarding, then cashing in.
